xange-bigblue:lever:71977770-494d-42f4-9.title: Customer Care Manager - Spain 🇪🇸
xange-bigblue:lever:71977770-494d-42f4-9.description: E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue, we’re on a mission to change that. We help brands by democratizing best-in-class operations: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience. Since 2018, we’ve built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 500+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, Scuffers and Cabaïa. With 110+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London, our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas, and a network of 7 warehouses across Europe, we’re solving logistics challenges that others haven’t dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, and greener. Backed by $20+M in funding and trusted by the next generation of e-commerce leaders, we’re scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward ambitious enterprise expansion. The journey ahead is bold, and we’re looking for the right partner to help us lead the way. About the role 🚀 Location: Madrid As a Customer Care Manager, you will take the lead of the Customer Care team in Spain in order to monitor the workload, the performance and to improve continuously processes. You will also be in direct contact with merchants for escalations and some tickets, and be in the heart of our operations to support our growth. Finally, you will contribute to the improvement of the app through your daily interactions with the Operations and Product teams. This job opening is intended to help structure the Care team in Spain. You will report directly to the Spain Merchant Team Lead. Missions ✍️ Manage & coach the Customer Care team - Lead the Spanish Care team on a daily basis to drive performance. - Ensure 1to1, performance reviews and other meetings with the Spanish Care Team. - Ensure tickets review with the Spanish Care team. - Provide coaching and support to the team when needed. Be the engine of the team performance - Monitor and analyze KPIs (CSAT, average reply time, average number of replies) to ensure quality. - Guarantee high responsiveness and service quality for tickets to thrive for excellence. - Participate to tickets handling with the team and merchants calls (around 20% of your time). - Be responsible for escalations from our merchants via calls and meetings. - Create Ad hoc strategic planning with merchants without an Account Manager. Lead the excellence of Care processes in Spain - Implement and update structured workflows / processes to manage Care requests efficiently. - Ensure streamlined communication with merchants in Care remit. - Align with the Account Management team to ensure a seamless experience for merchants. - Work closely with operations & product teams to ensure merchant feedback leads to meaningful improvements.

If you thrive in a scrappy, high-ownership environment where your work directly shapes the company’s trajectory, you’ll feel right at home here.

yc-zip:ashbyhq:3b54f98b-c0a7-4c6b-8a8b-b.title: Software Engineer, Forward Deployed (All Levels)
yc-zip:ashbyhq:3b54f98b-c0a7-4c6b-8a8b-b.description: ABOUT ZIP Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. YOUR ROLE You'll join Zip's Forward Deployed Software Engineering team as a software engineer on some of the highest-impact product work at the company. You'll write and ship production code, partner directly with our most critical customers, and own the engineering on the deals that matter most to Zip. The team operates close to the customer, moves with urgency, and builds the features that determine whether the biggest deals close on time, whether our most demanding customers stay on the leading edge of the product, and what enterprise-grade looks like in our platform. If you've done Forward Deployed work elsewhere, this is a place to keep doing it - on real product, at scale, for some of the most recognizable companies in the world. YOU WILL - Lead the engineering on critical customer projects. You'll own scope, sequencing, and delivery against the timelines that high-stakes deals demand, embedded in the implementation cadence alongside our Field PM and Solutions Consultants. - Ship high-impact features that move the most important strategic deals and renewals forward. The work this team takes on is what makes the platform enterprise-grade - net-new product capabilities, framework gaps (APIs, exports, notifications, etc), and targeted enhancements that ship in days or weeks. - Bring strong product sense to every decision. Partner with core product teams to decide what to build, what to push back on, and what to redirect. Strong opinions are welcome; strong opinions grounded in what you heard on a customer call are gold. - Shape Zip's long-term platform and roadmap. Features you ship land at our most critical customers first and compound into the platform, and the patterns you see first become next year's product investments. - Communicate directly with customers. You'll be on calls with procurement, finance, and IT teams, diagnose problems live against real deadlines, and translate trade-offs in language that lands with both engineers and executives. YOUR QUALIFICATIONS - Strong software engineering skills. You've shipped non-trivial production systems and you can read and write code across the stack: Python on the backend and React/TypeScript on the frontend at Zip. - Product instincts and judgment. You're the engineer on your current team who pushes back on poorly scoped requirements, who notices when a feature is solving the wrong problem, and who's willing to say so. - Customer empathy and crisp communication. You can sit in a room with a Director of Procurement at a $50B company, hear what they're actually worried about, and translate it into a tech spec, and vice versa. If you've never done this before but the idea sounds energizing, that counts. - Speed and urgency with a high quality bar. You can move on a customer-driven timeline and still write code that holds up in production. - High ownership. You diagnose, build, and ship with minimal supervision. You're the kind of engineer who follows a problem upstream until it's actually fixed. Helpful, not required: -
